messages:
Priya (Marketing): Quick heads-up  Nimbus wants a joint marketplace launch + webinar next Tue. Need blog, benchmark blurb, landing, and lead routing. Who takes what?
Eli (Demand Gen): I can do landing + HubSpot form + UTMs. Need speaker list by Fri EOD.
Samir (Partnerships): I'll confirm speakers and pull a partner quote. Also checking Nimbus amplification window.
Jordan (Product Marketing): I'll draft the benchmark narrative. Suggest calling out p95 latency and cost per 1k for an embeddings batch.
Leah (Solutions): I'll prep 30s + 90s demo clips showing marketplace provisioning -> private deploy.
Priya (Marketing): UTM scheme please: partner=nimbus, campaign=marketplace_co_launch, channel=webinar.
Eli (Demand Gen): UTM example:
```
utm_source=nimbus&utm_medium=partner_webinar&utm_campaign=marketplace_co_launch&utm_content=registration
```
HubSpot form id: 5f2a-landing-nimbus
Samir (Partnerships): Nimbus asks: route ARR>=50k leads to their AE, others to our demo queue. Can HubSpot do conditional assignment?
hubspot-bot: Workflow created: "nimbus_inbound_v1" (wf_9940). Trigger: form_submission -> evaluate_arr -> assign_owner.
Eli (Demand Gen): Yes hidden ARR field + workflow works. Leah, what's the demo queue tag?
Leah (Solutions): Tags: demo.type=integration, demo.source=marketplace, priority=standard. Adding to shared sheet.
Jordan (Product Marketing): Eng: need p95 (us-west2, 512 tokens), cost/1k, and error rate for a 24h run. Can we get numbers tonight?
Samir (Partnerships): Nimbus legal wants blog signoff within 48h of draft. Priya can you own approvals?
Priya (Marketing): I'll handle approvals and collate partner quote options.
Eli (Demand Gen): Webinar plan: 30m (18 demo, 7 Q&A, 5 CTAs). CTA -> choose a demo preference -> nurture track.
Priya (Marketing): Launch checklist: 1) Blog + quote (Jordan/Samir), 2) Landing + UTMs + form (Eli), 3) Demo clips + script (Leah), 4) Benchmark data (Eng->Jordan), 5) HubSpot workflows (Eli/hubspot-bot), 6) Legal approvals (Priya/Samir).
Priya (Marketing): Please drop a 1-line status update here by EOD. I'll assemble the launch brief and ping Nimbus.
Leah (Solutions): status: demo bullets in drive, recording slot booked.
Samir (Partnerships): status: speakers mostly confirmed, legal pinged.
Eli (Demand Gen): status: landing skeleton up, UTMs in place, form staged.
Jordan (Product Marketing): status: benchmark outline ready, awaiting p95/cost from eng.
Priya (Marketing): Thanks team :raised_hands: will share final brief by 8pm.
